items.quote: Do you secretly believe Dubai property prices are too expensive?
items.statement: Belief that Dubai property prices may be too expensive can hinder overcoming objections in sales.

items.quote: is this belief built on facts or just a gut feeling?
items.statement: To overcome objections, clarify if beliefs are based on facts or gut feelings.

items.quote: Once you clarify it for yourself, you'll be able to shift your perspective—and your clients’ too.
items.statement: Clarifying personal beliefs can help shift perspectives in client interactions.

items.quote: So, what objection has you tripping up the most? Share your “favorite” objection below.
items.statement: Encourages readers to share their most challenging objections in the comments.

overview: This is a LinkedIn post discussing beliefs about Dubai property prices and their impact on sales objections.
